SELECT c.category, e.course_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM enrollments e
JOIN courses c ON c.id = e.course_id
GROUP BY c.category, e.course_id
HAVING COUNT(*) = (
  SELECT MAX(t.cnt) FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM enrollments e2
    JOIN courses c2 ON c2.id = e2.course_id
    WHERE c2.category = c.category
    GROUP BY e2.course_id
  ) t
)
ORDER BY c.category

WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', enrolled_at) AS month, course_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM enrollments
  GROUP BY month, course_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT month, course_id, cnt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY cnt DESC, course_id ASC) AS rn
  FROM monthly
)
SELECT month, course_id, cnt
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1 AND cnt >= 5
ORDER BY month;
